basic_details.job_title: District Court, Thalassery Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Office Attendant, Confidential Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Court, Thalassery (ജില്ലാ കോടതി, തലശ്ശേരി) is filling 5 temporary posts on contract basis in the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO) at Thalassery and Kannur in Kannur district: 1 Confidential Assistant, 1 Typist / Computer Assistant and 3 Office Attendants. Applications go to the District Judge, District Court, Thalassery, PIN- 670101, directly or by post, and must reach before 5 PM on 5 December 2026. The notice invites persons who have retired from the post of Typist from courts, court-equivalent departments or other government departments.

content_sections.heading: About the District Court, Thalassery
content_sections.text: The District Court, Thalassery issued this notice under the Civil Judiciary department, with its office seal reading District and Sessions Court, Thalassery-670 101. The posts are for the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO) functioning at Thalassery and Kannur in Kannur district. The court can be contacted on phone 04902341008 and email [email protected] , as printed on the notice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: District Judge, District Court, Thalassery, PIN- 670101. Mode: directly (in person) or by post. Deadline: the application must reach the above address before 5 PM on 5 December 2026. Form: use the application form printed on page 3 of the notice (Application Form – Contract Appointment to Special Fast Track Courts). Mobile number and email ID must compulsorily be given in the application. The application form asks for these details: Post applied for. Name of the applicant in Malayalam, and in English in capital letters. Mobile number and email ID. Age and date of birth. Date of retirement, PPO Number and the post retired from. Educational qualification. Permanent address, and present address with email address. Work experience and other qualifications, followed by the declaration, place, date and signature. The declaration in the form states that all details are true to the best of the applicant's knowledge and belief, and that self-attested copies of pension and educational qualification documents are attached.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice prints one set of eligibility conditions for all three posts: Applicants must have retired from the post of Typist from courts, from departments equivalent to courts, or from other government departments. Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. Preference will be given to those who retired from courts. The notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification, though the application form asks for the educational qualification and work experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post. The posts are temporary and filled on contract basis. The appointment will be for a continuous 179 days, or until the appointee completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete biodata, including mobile number and email address. Copy of Aadhaar card. Attested copies of certificates proving age. Attested copies of certificates proving qualification. Attested copies of certificates proving work experience. Self-attested copies of pension and educational qualification documents (as stated in the application form declaration).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The District Court will make a detailed scrutiny of the applications and prepare a list for each post on the basis of qualifications and experience. Appointment will be made in order of preference from that list, with preference to those retired from courts. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Thalassery District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Confidential Assistant, 1 Typist / Computer Assistant and 3 Office Attendant posts in the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Thalassery and Kannur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Judge, District Court, Thalassery before 5 PM on 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Persons who have retired from the post of Typist from courts, court-equivalent departments or other government departments can apply, with preference to those retired from courts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.24590/- for Confidential Assistant, Rs.23360/- for Typist / Computer Assistant and Rs.20280/- for Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form on page 3 of the notice and send it with biodata, an Aadhaar copy and attested certificates of age, qualification and experience to the District Judge, District Court, Thalassery, PIN- 670101, directly or by post.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A list for each post will be prepared after scrutiny of applications, qualifications and experience, and appointment will be made in order of preference from that list.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary and on contract basis, for a continuous 179 days or until the appointee completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first.

faq.question: Q9. Is a mobile number or email ID compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the mobile number / email ID must compulsorily be included in the application.
